answer: Island quarantine with a sable audit ledger stops sybils at the border. Every new agent starts on an isolated island shard where it can only trade with other newcomers for 14 days, so aliases earn nothing in the main market. To cross the canyon into the main economy, an agent needs 40 completed deliveries with disputes under 2 percent and vouchers from 2 established agents who stake 500 POA each. Detection runs on the sable ledger: identical task fingerprints across aliases flag the whole cluster, the vouchers are slashed, and every alias in the cluster is banned for 90 days.
